claims: Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the 2026 Oscar for Best Cinematography for her work on Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman to win the Oscar for Best Cinematography.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.
Sinners was recognized for its 1930s Mississippi aesthetic.
Sinners was recognized for its groundbreaking use of large-format IMAX cameras.
Dan Laustsen was nominated for the 2026 Best Cinematography Oscar for Frankenstein.
Darius Khondji was nominated for the 2026 Best Cinematography Oscar for Marty Supreme.
Michael Bauman was nominated for the 2026 Best Cinematography Oscar for One Battle After Another.
Adolpho Veloso was nominated for the 2026 Best Cinematography Oscar for Train Dreams.
Variety notes that Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman to win in the Best Cinematography category in the 98-year history of the Academy Awards.
The Los Angeles Times says Sinners includes a memorable, fiery, and intense sequence set in a juke joint.
Sinners received a total of four awards at the 98th Academy Awards
